title: Dedicated capacity quick-cookbook: visual assets and screenshots for onboarding
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Create a compact visual 'quick-cookbook' for the Dedicated onboarding flow that includes capacity setup illustrations, autoscaling policy presets, and an SLA comparison overview. The goal is a set of responsive screenshots, annotated microcopy options, and a small library of micro-animations that can be dropped into the Quickstart guide and the product tour. Deliverables should support both self-serve and sales-assisted flows.
goals: Reduce time-to-first-safe-configuration for Dedicated customers by giving clear visual affordances for capacity and autoscale choices
Provide one canonical set of screenshots for docs, SDK quickstarts, and the product tour
Surface SLA tradeoffs and estimated cost impact visually so users can make informed reserve/burst decisions
deliverables: 6 annotated desktop screenshots (capacity wizard: estimate, slider, presets, review)
4 mobile-screen variants for the top onboarding steps
3 micro-animations (autoscale policy preview, burst toggle, SLA comparison flip) exported as MP4 and GIF
Artwork tokens and color passes for dark/light themes
Copy variants for microcopy A/B test (concise, explanatory, sales-led)
Figma file with componentized assets and a short handoff note
acceptance_criteria: All screenshots exported at 2x for retina and annotated with callouts
Micro-animations are under 3s and under 2MB for GIF fallbacks
Design review sign-off from PM and Eng (see comments) and accessibility checks for contrast and text size
Figma file contains tokens, components, and a simple test checklist for engineers (assets + alt text)
design_notes: Primary visual should emphasize tradeoffs: reserved vs burst pricing, latency SLOs, and scaling responsiveness
Avoid dense tables in the primary flow — use an interactive split-card to compare two profiles
Create a compact UI variant for small screens used in in-app help overlays
Microcopy: prefer second-person concise voice (you/your) for action steps; offer an explainer link for SLA technical details
